items.title: AM Best upgraded C&F Insurance Group (including United States Fire Insurance Company…
items.verbatim_quote: AM Best upgraded C&F Insurance Group (including United States Fire Insurance Company, TII's underwriter) to A+ Superior on August 28, 2025 — upgrading from A Excellent. C&F GWP reached $6.2B in 2025 (vs $5.7B in 2024, +8.8% YoY). The 4-year CAGR from 2021-2025 is approximately 13%. This financial strength upgrade at an accelerating growth trajectory indicates investment headroom for technology programmes and directly supports platform expansion budget approvals.

grounding.representative_quote: C&F's EVP issued a public statement in March 2026: 'On-Demand Coverage, Digital Claims Redefine Travel Insurance.'

items.title: C&F's EVP issued a public statement in March 2026: 'On-Demand Coverage…
items.verbatim_quote: C&F's EVP issued a public statement in March 2026: 'On-Demand Coverage, Digital Claims Redefine Travel Insurance.' This represents a board-level strategic commitment to transforming the claims experience — directly acknowledging TII's most visible customer pain point (months-long claim waits, BBB complaints, Trustpilot 4.4★ with claims speed as the primary driver of negative reviews). Digital claims transformation is now an explicitly stated corporate objective.

grounding.representative_quote: Chris Livingston promoted to Deputy CISO (March 2025), now directing the Security Operations and Engineering team and the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team.

items.title: Chris Livingston promoted to Deputy CISO (March 2025)…
items.verbatim_quote: Chris Livingston promoted to Deputy CISO (March 2025), now directing the Security Operations and Engineering team and the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team. Livingston built what CISO Holden publicly characterised as 'an exceptional third-party risk management program and a world-class cloud and applications security program.' C&F separately launched CISO Professional Liability Insurance (November 2024) — a product that demonstrates deep internal cybersecurity expertise at board level.

items.title: Denise Bialek appointed VP, Business Development & Partnerships (January 2026)…
items.verbatim_quote: Denise Bialek appointed VP, Business Development & Partnerships (January 2026). This hire signals active channel expansion beyond TII's existing portfolio (USAA 14M-member affinity, Squaremouth aggregator, direct agency distribution). The January 2025 launch of the 3-tier product suite (Essential/Deluxe/Platinum) was specifically designed with flexible channel deployment in mind — providing the product architecture to support new distribution relationships at scale.

grounding.representative_quote: Jared Ionin appointed Chief Digital Officer, C&F A&H Division (November 21, 2025).

items.title: Jared Ionin appointed Chief Digital Officer, C&F A&H Division (November 21, 2025)…
items.verbatim_quote: Jared Ionin appointed Chief Digital Officer, C&F A&H Division (November 21, 2025). His mandate: 'strengthening digital infrastructure and establishing a roadmap for continued innovation and scalability.' This marks the first time a dedicated CDO has been appointed to the A&H division — signalling a formally funded digital transformation programme at the TII level. The appointment follows S&S Division's proven AI success (S&S UP, 35% turnaround reduction, Datos Insights 2025 Award) and Brizzi CDO's December 2025 statement that AI's most tangible impact is underwriting productivity.

items.verbatim_quote: TII launched its new 3-tier product suite (Essential, Deluxe, Platinum) in January 2025, replacing the legacy Worldwide Trip Protector and WTP Edge products. Each tier offers configurable optional coverage bundles — a meaningful shift from fixed-benefit products to flexible, modular coverage architecture. This is the most significant product architecture change TII has made in several years.
